newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Ta Fu offers 168 mln new shrs at HK$1.01 each.
newsitem.headline: Ta Fu offers 168 mln new shrs at HK$1.01 each.

text.p: Taiwan-based timber products processor Ta Fu International Holdings Ltd said on Friday it was offering 168 million new shares, or 20.3 percent of the company's enlarged share capital, at HK$1.01 per share.
Ta Fu is one of the largest timber products processors in China with extensive manufacturing facilities. It has 19 joint ventures in China, an associate company in Taiwan and a subsidiary in Brazil.
The company has a diversified products range including wood-panel products such as veneer and fancy plywood, and end-user items such as furniture, doors and flooring.
Ta Fu's managing director Anthony Fan said he believed the group would benefit from China's massive housing development programme over the next few years.
Credit Lyonnais Securities (Asia) Ltd is the sponsor and lead underwriter of the issue.
